title: Unifont CSUR
description: Adds the conlang fonts from Unifont to the game. Tengwar, Sitelen Pona, Klingon, and many more!
body:
Adds the Private Use Area CSUR glyphs from Unifont CSUR to the game. This adds script support for Tengwar (Elvish), Sitelen Pona, Klingon, and many more! This is done through TTF and supports diacritics and similar features (if supported by the font).

If you would like to know what characters to type, please refer to [CSUR](https://www.evertype.com/standards/csur/).

# Known issues
- The rendering currently has issues with glow ink
- Diacritics often arent in the correct place (this is an issue with the font)
